description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class `EmployeeSupervisorModelTest` that tests the `EmployeeSupervisorModel` class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup of mock employee and reporting entities and verifies the output of the `toArray()` method of `EmployeeSupervisorModel`.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorModelTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmployeeSupervisorModel's toArray method, verifying correct serialization of supervisor and reporting details.

methods.name: testToArray
methods.description: Tests the conversion of a ReportTo entity into an associative array representing supervisor and reporting method details.
